newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: OLS says Hong Kong listing oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: OLS says Hong Kong listing oversubscribed.

text.p: Fit-out and construction group OLS Asia Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday a share issue for 30 percent of subsidiary OLS Group Ltd has been 17 times oversubscribed.
OLS Asia is offering 108 million shares in OLS Group, which is due to list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on Thursday, at HK$1.65 (A$0.30) each. Another 12 million shares were offered to employees.
OLS Group chairman Alfred Siu said the company had received 11,479 applications for a total of more than 1.83 billion shares.
The oversubscription was a vote of confidence in the company's prospects and the underlying value of the region's construction industry, Siu said.
OLS Group will consolidate all of OLS's fit-out and construction operations in Hong Kong, China and South East Asia.
The Australian-listed OLS Asia will retain 70 percent ownership.
"Because of the strong pre-listing demand, we expect OLS Group Ltd to come on to the Hong Kong market at a premium," Siu said.
Pratt Industries, the privately-owned Australian paper, packaging and investment group, bought a nine percent stake in OLS Asia earlier this month.
The 5.4 million shares went through the market at A$1.15 each, brokers said.
OLS Asia was seven cents firmer at A$1.40 at 3.05 p.m. (1505 GMT).
